Anna (CS): Heads-up: Zephyr onboarding cohort (Acct: Zephyr Labs) needs two 45m office hours next week. Can we split by timezone and keep the same agenda?

Mike (Enablement): Yes. Propose Wed 09:00 PT / Thu 17:00 CET. Quick poll to confirm availability? :spiral_calendar:

Sara (SuccessOps): Wed 09:00 PT works for me. Can we ensure a facilitator for the live lab portion?

Josh (AM): Add me for Wed. Customer asked for hands-on lab + Q&A — prioritize eng access. Also flag: renewal paperwork is pending, keep the agenda focused.

Mike (Enablement): I'll create invites. Do we want a 1-page pre-read + a short config checklist? Suggest: prework + required account roles. :thumbsup:

Anna (CS): Yes — pre-read required. Include a tiny troubleshooting snippet for common token errors. Also note renewal risk in CRM so CS can follow up post-session.

Mike (Enablement): Draft invite body below — please review:

```
Title: Redwood Enablement — Zephyr Labs Onboarding Office Hours
When: Wed 2026-03-25 09:00 PT / Thu 2026-03-26 17:00 CET
Duration: 45 minutes
Agenda: setup check (10m), live walkthrough (20m), Q&A + next steps (15m)
Prework: share API key & sample dataset, run smoke test
Join: Zoom link (will be in calendar)
Note: sessions are limited to admin + engineering contacts due to renewal discussion
```

Sara (SuccessOps): Looks good. I'll add recording opt-out and set auto-reminders: 24h and 1h. Also enable 2-minute post-session CS feedback survey.

EnablementBot: Reminder scheduled: SMS reminder 1 hour before for RSVP=yes list. Template: "Ready for workshop? Reply '1' to confirm."

Josh (AM): For attendees flagged as "renewal risk" — do not include contract details in the invite. CS will follow up with a dedicated call.

Anna (CS): Task list:
- Mike: create invites + attach prework doc
- Sara: enable reminders + set recording preference + feedback survey
- Josh: prepare renewal follow-up note for CS handoff

Mike (Enablement): On it. Will post calendar links and the prework doc in #customer-updates when done.

Anna (CS): If there are no blockers, I'll finalize invites & CRM note by EOD. :calendar:

Sara (SuccessOps): No blockers from my side; will confirm facilitator names shortly.

EnablementBot: Calendar invites sent to 12 recipients (Zephyr contacts).
